title: GIX SurvivalCraft
description: A brutal survival server with a fresh twist on vanilla — conquer custom challenges, delve into deadly dungeons, and earn powerful gear by defeating unique bosses.
body:
A brutal survival server with a fresh twist on vanilla — conquer custom challenges, delve into deadly dungeons, and earn powerful gear by defeating unique bosses.
We feature both a claim and no claim world, for both play styles. Several custom plugins including a custom dungeon plugin exclusive to our server!
